description: The Australian Bureau of Statistics produced the Water Account, Australia, which gives national and state and territory estimates of water supply, use and consumption in physical and monetary supply and use tables, with summary indicators and household and industry water prices. The 2023-24 edition reports national consumption of 17,223 GL, of which agriculture used 11,760 GL and households 1,868 GL, and a time series from 2014-15. Coverage is Australia by state and territory, annually. The tables are a free download from the release page. Caveats: irrigation water use now comes from an experimental CSIRO satellite evapotranspiration model instead of surveys, so the method changed in this edition, and the account is not broken down below state level. Simulation uses: demand totals by sector and state for water supply capacity planning and drought scenarios. Related records: the Bureau of Meteorology urban water performance report (data-bom-national-performance-report-urban-water).
